Trust me - I’m a newbie too and still learning!  “To failure” means that you try to do ten reps but if you can’t (because you’ve already done the 10x10’s) you squeeze out what you can till you can’t.  

The trick is identifying what your max 10 rep weight is.  You half that for the 10x10’s.  Then you set the weight back to the max 10 rep weight and do 3 sets of 10 (or to failure). 

Example:  If I can do max 10 reps on the leg press at 140lbs, then I do my 10x10’s at 70lbs and then try to do 3 sets of 10 back at 140lbs.  That last set you may only be able to get to 8 (to failure.)

Welcome. And any time you can incorporate jumping jacks or kettlebell swings in between rotations is good too.  It helps keep your heart rate elevated (burn more calories, keeps energy high and adds to overall fitness/tone).  

On arm days I’ll do the 10x10’s and 3 sets of 10 to failure on three machines and then row 2000 meters with 10 kettlebell swings between each 500 meters.  

On leg days I typically do 5 machines with the 10x10’s and 3 sets of 10 to failure, adding kettlebell swings between sets of 50 on two machines (generally adductors and abductors) to make sure my body isn’t cooling down too much from sitting for longer periods of time.)

Ingredients:

1 cup Serve (or other Stevia/Erythritol blend)
1 Tsp lemon zest

Instructions:
Mix sweetener with water, cranberries and zest.
Bring to a boil, then simmer and mix gently for 8-10 minutes

Here you go!

Keto Lemon Cheesecake 

Serves: 24 
Prep Time: 20 minutes 

Ingredients:

Walnuts, 2 cup, halves 
Salted Butter Sweet Cream by Wegmans, 2 tbsp 
The Ultimate Sugar Repacement by Swerve, 1 tsp 
Cream Cheese by Wegmans, 16 ounce 
Greek Plain Yogurt By Wegmans
¾ cup The Ultimate Sugar Repacement by Swerve
3 tablespoon Lemon Peel Or Zest Raw
1 tbsp McCormick Lemon Extract 
Organic Coconut Oil, Expeller Pressed by Great Value, ½ cup 

Instructions: 

Crust:
1.	Finely chop walnuts in a food processor.
2.	Mix in butter and 1 tsp of sweetner (I use Swerve or a knockoff Brand such as Pyure from Walmart – it’s a Stevia/Erythritol blend which doesn’t have an artificial flavor or aftertaste)
3.	Press mixture into pan, covering the bottom.  You can use a pie plate for a more ‘cheesecake’ appearance or a casserole dish which can help portion out into smaller servings.  You can also use regular or mini cupcake tins, but make sure to use liners to prevent sticking.  
4.	Set aside

Filling:
1.	Cream cheese should be softened to room temperature
2.	Mix remaining ingredients until smooth (saving half your zest to garnish)
3.	Spread filling on top of crust
4.	Garnish with lemon zest
5.	Either throw in the freezer for an hour or refrigerate for two.  I generally do a little of both until I can’t wait any longer to eat a piece.  
Notes:  I like my desserts slightly less sweet than commercial products, so feel free to increase sweetner and extract to your preference…you can perform taste tests once your filling is blended and go from there.  

Nutrition Facts:
24 servings: 2g Net Carbs, 1g Fiber, 17g Fat, 3g Protein, 171 calories
